linux-flatpak.reason: The official download page lists Linux archives and a .deb but no Flatpak package or manifest.

controller_boundary.refusal: Do not invent a Retro Virtual Machine controller writer: the current v2 desktop release is not source-published, and the pinned v1 HID mapping bytes are not a verified cross-version contract.

notes: Retro Virtual Machine v2.1.20 is distributed for Windows, macOS and Linux; no official Flatpak is listed. The last public source is v1.1.x for macOS, so current runtime launch, persistence and effective controller input remain unverified.
